text_block_list.text:
On this day, I was invited to a tea party 
hosted by the Mejiro family and visited 
their mansion, but Mejiro Bright seemed 
somewhat off.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
As an Umamusume of the Mejiro family, I 
must endure this tea party...

text_block_list.name: Auntie
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, Bright-chan! Perfect timing! I was 
actually just heading to the kitchen to 
make those brownies from before.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Howaa, is that the brownie from back 
then~!

text_block_list.name: Auntie
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, you used to eat these with 
Ryan-chan all the time, right? Want some?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It looks so tempting, but I think I'll 
stick to just tea today~

text_block_list.name: Auntie
text_block_list.text:
It could affect your races and all, after 
all. Well then, farewell! Now then, who 
hasn't I spoken to yet...
choice_data_list:
...Could it be that you're holding back on 
sweets?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes~. I decided that I would like to 
follow Lady McQueen's example as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"As an Umamusume of the Mejiro family, I 
cannot allow myself to show any disgrace," 
she was telling the mirror with a serious 
look on her face.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: My beloved Lady McQueen said so herself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I thought it would not do for me to lose 
myself in sweets~
choice_data_list: In that case, let's enjoy some tea.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes♪ It is truly reassuring to have you by 
my side, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Let us devote ourselves with unwavering 
resolve, just like Lady McQueen~♪

text_block_list.name: Auntie
text_block_list.text:
Then McQueen-chan gets two slices of 
brownies.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
N-No... I think I will decline after 
all...

And thus, Mejiro Bright and the others 
enjoyed their tea time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Umm, like I said~ I also share Lady 
McQueen's wishes—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Fufu, indeed it is.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Merely imitating others makes you no 
different from a little child.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
What you truly need to learn lies 
elsewhere, it seems.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I shall head to the kitchen. I will bring 
some back for you as well, Trainer.

And so, Mejiro Bright enjoyed the taste of 
memories to her heart's content!
